label: 2026 midterm elections
detail: All 435 House seats, 35 Senate seats (including specials in Florida and Ohio) and 36 governors.

label: Georgia runoff, if needed
detail: Georgia requires a majority; if no one tops 50%, the top two meet four weeks later.
source: Georgia law (runoff 28 days after the general election)

label: Louisiana House runoffs, if needed
detail: Top two from the Nov. 3 all-party House primary, where no one won a majority.

label: 2027 governor races
detail: Kentucky, Louisiana and Mississippi elect governors; New Jersey and Virginia elect legislatures.

label: 2028 presidential election
detail: President, a third of the Senate and all 435 House seats.
source: Federal law: the Tuesday after the first Monday in November
